data.narrative:
Ample, a Series C climate and energy company founded by Khaled Hassounah and John De Souza, has raised $720.2M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 3 same-stage, same-sector comparables (KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Amogy) alongside a broader universe of 8 private peers and 1 public comparable (LNZA).

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total capital raised as a proxy baseline and applying a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical of Series C advancement, implies a valuation of $1.2B. Peer-median analysis across the three identified comparables yields $1.0B, with the peer set ranging from $700M (Amogy) to $3.0B (KoBold Metals). The peer median method anchors the lower end of the range; stage-progression anchors the upper end.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $850M to $1.4B, with a median of $1.1B. This range reflects moderate dispersion in the peer universe, particularly the $3.0B outlier (KoBold), which widens uncertainty in sector-wide comparables at this stage. Key sensitivities include capital efficiency relative to peers and trajectory toward Series D or later financing milestones, neither of which are fully resolved by current data.
